title: Add diagram-skills as a federated marketplace entry
description: Dispatched by opum-agent (opum-doc DEC-168 (3)). diagram-skills is a new public repo (github.com/opum-ai/diagram-skills, MIT) shipping six skills (diagram-architecture, diagram-data, diagram-decision, diagram-plan, diagram-process, diagram-review) for explaining and diagramming architectures, processes, decisions, data and plans with Mermaid in Markdown, pitched to the reader level, drawn from real Quest and lore records, and checked for syntax, legibility, accessibility and truth. Repo-root layout (.claude-plugin/plugin.json and skills/ at the root), matching the existing entries. Pin v0.1.0 (annotated tag). Independently resolved via the GitHub git-database API before pinning: tag ref v0.1.0 -> tag object 031d53bb5062b3d94cd77a523ee6ca855d7a0517 (type=tag) -> commit 15469fd1fbc1f602508de6131778222f01385b5e -> root tree 136f92111bd2dfd478fd19f145f555a08ba57183 -> skills subtree 8747c68d52f333ff074a9e72c9be09a6865fa8c8. plugin.json at the tag declares name diagram-skills, version 0.1.0, author {name: Opum AI, url: https://github.com/opum-ai}, license MIT. The diagram-skills default branch is dev, now ahead of the tag (dev HEAD 3a613d874264e23522c279e55acfe2050c546430); the pin is to the immutable release tag, not the branch.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A plugins[] entry named "diagram-skills" exists in .claude-plugin/marketplace.json with source {source:"github", repo:"opum-ai/diagram-skills", ref:"v0.1.0"}, author {name:"Opum AI", url:"https://github.com/opum-ai"}, category documentation, and homepage https://github.com/opum-ai/diagram-skills

scripts/federated-pin-baselines.json records a diagram-skills baseline for v0.1.0 with an independently-resolved skills/ subtree SHA (tag ref -> tag object -> commit -> root tree -> skills subtree), not a relayed one taken on trust
node scripts/check-federated-pins.mjs and node scripts/check-federated-content.mjs both report diagram-skills checked/verified (not skipped) against the live tag
node scripts/generate-codex-marketplace.mjs --check passes after regenerating .agents/plugins/marketplace.json for the new entry
The marketplace description, README.md and docs/reference/marketplace-federation-contract.md name and count seven plugins, including diagram-skills
check · manifests, lore check and Tracker integrity are green in CI on the PR head SHA

finalSummary: Added diagram-skills (opum-ai/diagram-skills, pinned v0.1.0, MIT) as a seventh federated entry in .claude-plugin/marketplace.json - github source, author {name: Opum AI, url: https://github.com/opum-ai}, category documentation, homepage https://github.com/opum-ai/diagram-skills - per opum-doc DEC-168 (3). Resolved the tag chain independently via the GitHub git-database API (annotated tag v0.1.0 -> tag object 031d53bb5062b3d94cd77a523ee6ca855d7a0517 -> commit 15469fd1fbc1f602508de6131778222f01385b5e -> root tree 136f92111bd2dfd478fd19f145f555a08ba57183 -> skills subtree 8747c68d52f333ff074a9e72c9be09a6865fa8c8), recorded in scripts/federated-pin-baselines.json; plugin.json at the tag declares version 0.1.0. Regenerated .agents/plugins/marketplace.json; README.md and docs/reference/marketplace-federation-contract.md updated from six plugins to seven; lore sync. Verified locally (claude plugin validate, both federated checkers naming diagram-skills, codex --check, 25-case JS suite plus the fast-forward guard suite, lore check 0 errors) and in CI: PR opum-ai/opum-marketplace#197, run 37539589729 on head a0788849, check · manifests / lore check / Tracker integrity all green, with the manifests job log naming diagram-skills as checked and content-verified.
